title_sq: Apartament 2+1+2 per per shitje rrugen Margarita Tutulani
description_sq:
Ne rrugen Margarita Tutulani, ofrohet per shitje apartament modern 2+1+2, siperfaqe 115 m², kati 5 banim ne nje pallat te ri .
Apartamenti organizohet ne: dhome ndenje dhe ambient gatimi, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete, koridor, ballkon.
I gjithe apartamenti eshte i mobiluar 
Ndodhet ne nje nga zonat me te preferuara ne Tirane, me te gjitha fasilitetet e nevojshme afer, shume prane parkut te madh te liqenit.

title_en: 2+1+2 apartment for sale, Margarita Tutulani street
description_en: On Margarita Tutulani street, a modern apartment 2+1+2, surface area 115 m², 5th floor in a new building is offered for sale. The apartment is organized in: living room and kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, corridor, balcony. The entire apartment is furnished. It is located in one of the most popular areas in Tirana, with all the necessary facilities nearby, very close to the large lake park. For sale, 300,000 euros
